title.narrative: Cities 4 Women - Supporting Inclusive and Resilient Urbanization in Nepal

description.narrative:
UNOPS in partnership with Cities Alliance, UN-Habitat, and the European Union, promote Inclusive and Climate Resilient urbanization in Nepal.

The project aims to promote women’s leadership and participation in decision-making at the local level, support the development of gender-inclusive city strategies, and drive demonstrative pilot actions. 
This includes the following: 
A Policy review to support the creation of a gender-inclusive framework for Nepal’s National Urban Development Strategy (NUDS), 
To promote women’s leadership and participation in decision-making at the local level and to support the transformative action of the women leaders in five municipalities. Co-finance Proof of Concept projects t support the creation of pilot spatial interventions dedicated to women through a participatory process, topping up the municipal annual budgets (co-financing). Knowledge Management to foster exchange and cross-fertilization between the five cities, Academia, and governmental Knowledge Institutions, regarding gender-inclusive and climate-resilient city strategies
